abstract: We present CLASSIX, an open-source Python library for fast and explainable clustering. The library provides a unified interface to three metric-specific implementations, compiled acceleration with portable Python fallbacks, and extensive user and developer documentation. CLASSIX accepts NumPy arrays and Pandas DataFrames and is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/nla-group/classix.
title: CLASSIX: A High-Performance Library for Explainable~Clustering
title_html: CLASSIX: A High-Performance Library for Explainable Clustering
